chars.FAHD: FAHD: a skinny 24-year-old Moroccan man wearing a bright mustard-yellow hoodie, light blue jeans and white sneakers.
chars.SALWA: SALWA: a confident young Moroccan woman, a bit older, wearing big round black glasses, a long burgundy cardigan over a black turtleneck, beige wide trousers and a small black handbag.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: In a Casablanca street cafe terrace, SALWA firmly pulls a thick white salary envelope full of banknotes out of FAHD's hands; FAHD leans back holding the other end of the envelope, shocked and confused, SALWA looks bossy and determined. Both face each other in clear tension, comic mood.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Inside a Moroccan shopping mall, FAHD struggles carrying many colorful shopping bags and boxes stacked to his chin, sweating, while SALWA walks ahead pointing at another shop window with a happy face.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: In a small Moroccan apartment living room, SALWA scolds FAHD like a strict mother, wagging her finger at him; FAHD holds open his empty hands with coins falling through his fingers to the floor, embarrassed.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: At a Moroccan cafe table with two mint tea glasses, SALWA leans across the table with a sly smile, whispering a secret plan to FAHD, who leans in curious with wide eyes.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: SALWA holds out her open palm and FAHD hands her most of a stack of banknotes, keeping only a few notes for himself; SALWA smiles sweetly and puts the money into her small black handbag. Simple Moroccan living room background.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: FAHD squeezed inside a very crowded old city bus in Casablanca, standing and holding the overhead bar, other faceless passengers pressed around him, he looks at a few coins in his palm with a tired face.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: At a nice Moroccan restaurant table with tajine plates, SALWA proudly hands cash to a waiter to pay the bill, while FAHD sits next to her amazed and impressed, hands on his cheeks.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: FAHD and SALWA shake hands to seal a deal in a Moroccan living room; FAHD grins happily with a naive face giving a thumbs up with his other hand, SALWA smiles with a mysterious satisfied look.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: At night in a modest Moroccan bedroom lit by moonlight, FAHD lies in bed under a blanket smiling and dreaming, a dream cloud above his head shows a big pile of banknotes and a small shiny car.
